First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tuesday Night Women's Gravel Ride group ride

Tuesday Night Women's Gravel Ride is a gravel group ride in Papillion, NE. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from Papio South.

A women's gravel ride hosted by Omaha Velo and The Bike Way, leaving from the Papio South trailhead south of Omaha. Same group runs a Saturday 8 am gravel ride from Walnut Creek.
